context: Strangler sequence: (w1) characterization tests pinning current CLI run behavior for a representative matrix (duckdb tpch sql, a dataframe platform, phases variants, tuning modes, dry-run) -- these are the safety net for every later move; (w2) create the service with a typed RunRequest/RunPlan boundary (resolution only, no execution) and port config resolution; (w3) port execution orchestration around core/runner/runner.py with injected adapter factory; (w4) migrate CLI orchestrator onto the service, delete the moved CLI code; (w5) move presort defaults into benchmark registry metadata. Keep each work unit a separately landable PR. Interactive wizardry, display, and credential prompting stay in the CLI layer. Watch the fast-lane test cap when adding characterization tests; they may belong in the medium lane.
description: Keystone of the one-engine program; the file path benchbox/core/run_service.py was already reserved in the superseded decision's scope. Today there are two live benchmark-run pipelines: CLI (benchbox/cli/orchestrator.py 601 lines + benchbox/cli/execution_pipeline.py 430 lines: hooks, credential setup, cloud staging, driver metadata, provenance) and MCP (_run_benchmark_impl in benchbox/mcp/tools/benchmark.py ~1000 lines: direct adapter + run_with_platform calls with its own mode/phase/option handling). Extract into a core run service the logic that must be identical: 14-step config resolution (run.py:1276-1301 _prepare_run_state), tuning/compression precedence (run.py:1199-1252), data-organization derivation (run.py:205-289 -- move the hardcoded TPC-H lineitem.l_shipdate / TPC-DS store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk presort defaults into benchmark registry metadata), platform-mode/deployment resolution (run.py:970-1032), phase parsing/validation + execution-type derivation (run.py:505-526, :838-916; MCP benchmark.py:165-186), and ExecutionContext/provenance construction (run.py:308-361). CLI orchestrator/execution_pipeline become thin consumers in this item; MCP adoption is the follow-up item. CRITICAL LAYERING CONSTRAINT: .importlinter enforces utils < core < platforms < cli, so core may NOT import benchbox.platforms -- the run service must receive adapters/adapter factories by injection from the calling layer, mirroring how core/runner/runner.py already stays below platforms.

anti_patterns.dont: import benchbox.platforms from the run service to construct adapters
anti_patterns.instead: accept an adapter or adapter-factory parameter injected by the surface layer
anti_patterns.why: .importlinter layers contract: core < platforms; violating it breaks CI lint and the architecture

anti_patterns.dont: move the interactive wizard, credential prompting, or display code into core
anti_patterns.instead: leave interaction in the CLI layer; the service takes fully-resolved inputs
anti_patterns.why: interaction-scoped logic is legitimately surface-specific under the new contract

anti_patterns.instead: move code verbatim first; improvements are separate PRs after characterization holds
anti_patterns.why: extraction diffs must be reviewable as pure moves or every regression hides in the noise

anti_patterns.dont: route MCP through BenchmarkOrchestrator as a shortcut
anti_patterns.instead: MCP adopts the new core service in the follow-up item
anti_patterns.why: preserved guidance from the superseded decision; orchestrator is CLI-layer and carries interactive assumptions

deferrals.reason: Rung 4 is '! grep -rn l_shipdate|ss_sold_date_sk benchbox/cli/'. At develop f8713f2b37 it returns four hits, only two of which are defects. benchbox/cli/tuning.py:781 and :786 are a real hardcoded benchmark presort default (tracked as cli-tuning-wizard-presort-hint-divergence). benchbox/cli/commands/convert.py:166 and :170 are '--partition l_shipdate' usage examples inside a command docstring -- prose describing a user-supplied flag value, not a presort default, and l_shipdate is exactly the recognizable TPC-H column a reader would expect there. Narrow the rung to executable code (or exclude docstring/comment lines) rather than degrading the example.
deferrals.resolved_reason: Rung 4 greps prose as well as code: convert.py:166,170 are docstring examples of --partition l_shipdate, not hardcoded defaults; only tuning.py:781,786 are defects.
